budgetFields.label: Total Budget (USD)
budgetFields.note: Global spend budget across the runtime. Keep this editable even after onboarding.
budgetFields.title: Total budget

budgetFields.label: Per-task Cost Cap (USD)
budgetFields.note: Hard cap over one task's WHOLE tree, subagents included: further model calls are refused and the task is force-stopped once the tree's accounted spend reaches this (a graceful wrap-up fires just before). The wrap-up itself needs about $3.00 of room, so a cap at or below that finalizes the task immediately instead of running any work rounds.
budgetFields.title: Per-task cost cap

modelSlots.label: Light Model
modelSlots.note: Fast summaries, lightweight internal work, reflections, and the default Fast scout. Empty uses Main.

modelSlots.label: Vision Model
modelSlots.note: Caption and VLM lane. Empty uses Main.

modelSlots.label: Consciousness Model
modelSlots.note: High-horizon background consciousness. Empty uses Main.

providerFields.note: Optional. Best when you want one router for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more.

providerFields.label: OpenAI API Key

providerFields.label: Cloud.ru Foundation Models API Key

providerFields.label: MiniMax API Key
providerFields.note: Optional. If this is the only remote key, the next step prefills direct minimax::... models.

providerFields.label: OpenAI-compatible Base URL
providerFields.note: Base URL for your OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM). Required when using openai-compatible:: models.

providerFields.label: OpenAI-compatible API Key
providerFields.note: API key for the endpoint. Leave empty if your server does not require authentication.

anthropic.label: Anthropic
anthropic.modelCopy: Anthropic-only setup detected. These defaults are explicit and official.
anthropic.providerCopy: Anthropic is present, so the next step prefills direct anthropic:: model values.

cloudru.label: Cloud.ru Foundation Models
cloudru.modelCopy: Cloud.ru-only setup detected. These defaults use explicit cloudru:: model IDs.
cloudru.providerCopy: Cloud.ru is present, so the next step prefills direct cloudru:: model values.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.modelCopy: DeepSeek-only setup detected. These defaults use deepseek-v4-pro for main work and deepseek-v4-flash for the light lane. Blocking deep/scope review in Max context mode additionally needs the owner 1M-window acknowledgement in Settings.
deepseek.providerCopy: DeepSeek is present, so the next step prefills direct deepseek:: model values.

direct-multi.label: Direct multi-provider
direct-multi.modelCopy: Multiple direct providers are configured. Start here, then split model slots across them if you want.
direct-multi.providerCopy: Multiple direct providers are present, so the next step keeps your model values editable without forcing one provider family.

local.label: Local-first
local.modelCopy: Local-only setup detected. Review the model values and local routing before launch.
local.providerCopy: No remote key is present yet, so local-only setup remains available below.

minimax.label: MiniMax
minimax.modelCopy: MiniMax-only setup detected. These defaults include MiniMax-M3 and MiniMax-M2.7.
minimax.providerCopy: MiniMax is present, so the next step prefills direct minimax:: model values.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.modelCopy: OpenAI-only setup detected. These defaults are explicit and official.
openai.providerCopy: OpenAI is present, so the next step prefills direct openai:: model values.

openai-compatible.label: OpenAI-compatible endpoint
openai-compatible.modelCopy: OpenAI-compatible endpoint detected. Use openai-compatible::your-model-name for every slot. The model list is whatever your server supports.
openai-compatible.providerCopy: An OpenAI-compatible base URL is configured. Enter the model names your server exposes in the next step.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.modelCopy: OpenRouter-style routing remains active. Unprefixed provider IDs like openai/gpt-5.6-terra or anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 continue to route through OpenRouter.
openrouter.providerCopy: OpenRouter is present, so the next step keeps router-style defaults while still saving any extra direct keys you paste here.

reviewModes.copy: Faster and cheaper. Review still runs, but you decide how to handle findings. Best when you want iteration speed and can manually watch for drift.
reviewModes.label: Advisory

reviewModes.copy: Slower and more expensive, but much safer. Critical review findings stop commits, which dramatically reduces the chance of gradual code degradation.
reviewModes.label: Blocking

runtimeModes.copy: Self-modification of the main repo is disabled. Best for trying Ouroboros out without repo self-modification.
runtimeModes.label: Light

runtimeModes.copy: Self-modification of the evolutionary layer is allowed (current behaviour). Protected core/contract/release files stay guarded by Advanced mode.
runtimeModes.label: Advanced

runtimeModes.copy: Direct protected-surface mode. Protected core/contract/release edits are allowed on disk, but commits still require the normal triad + scope review gate.
runtimeModes.label: Pro

steps.copy: Fill at least one remote key or a local model source. The next step adapts to what you configured here.
steps.footer: Paste only what you already have. OpenRouter, direct provider keys, and an optional local model can coexist.
steps.title: Add your access

steps.copy: Optional. Ouroboros already runs on the access you just added. Signing in to an agent plan moves delegated subagents and commit review onto that plan instead of per-call API spend.
steps.footer: Skippable. Connect, add, or change agent accounts any time in Settings → Agents.
steps.title: Connect your agents

steps.copy: Review the visible model defaults derived from your current setup, then edit anything you want before launch.
steps.footer: Plain openai/... or anthropic/... remains router-style. Direct values use openai::... and anthropic::....
steps.title: Choose models

steps.copy: Decide how strict pre-commit review should be before Ouroboros starts modifying itself.
steps.footer: Pick both review enforcement and the initial runtime mode before Ouroboros starts.
steps.title: Choose review mode

steps.copy: Budget is its own step because it directly shapes how far Ouroboros can go in one session and in a single task.
steps.footer: Total budget is global. Per-task cost cap is a hard cap over one task's whole tree, subagents included: the task wraps up gracefully just before the ledger fence force-stops it.
steps.title: Set your budget

steps.copy: Check the final provider, model, review, and budget picture. Ouroboros will save these onboarding values before starting.
steps.footer: The same onboarding values remain editable later in Settings.
steps.title: Review before launch

subscriptionFields.label: Agent subscription connected
subscriptionFields.note: Set by the wizard when at least one agent account was signed in during onboarding. The server re-reads the live account state before applying anything.

subscriptionFields.label: Finish without agent defaults
subscriptionFields.note: Completes onboarding without moving reviewers and subagents onto the connected subscriptions. Everything stays editable in Settings afterwards.
